::: {.bio}
Viswa Challa has spent nine years at the intersection of data, technology, and progressive organizing. As Data and Analytics Manager at **People's Action**, he built the data infrastructure that powered a 4 million dial program — reducing cost per dial, sharpening audience segmentation, and making operational scale visible through hard numbers. He previously served as Data Director for the Minnesota office of **America Votes** and as Operations Director for **Neighbors for Ilhan Omar**. He also developed a framework for how organizations can implement Measuring Power with real technical depth. He holds a background in computer science.

Outside of work, he's usually chasing the next great film, planning a trip, or editing photos from the last one. Cinema has been a lifelong passion, and photography his way of slowing down and paying attention. When not doing any of that, he's deep in some personal tech project at home — tinkering with a self-hosted server or finding a better way to organize his digital life. It's the same itch that drew him to systems work professionally, just pointed in a different direction.
:::
